app.name: GymBhai
app.tagline: Memberships, renewals and check-ins for your gym.
home.pitch: No member trains on an expired membership, and nobody's renewal is forgotten.
home.feature.members.title: Members and renewals
home.feature.members.body: Every membership, payment and due amount in one list, on your phone or the counter computer.
home.feature.reminders.title: Reminders that go out
home.feature.reminders.body: Members hear from you before a membership ends, by SMS and in their app.
home.feature.door.title: A QR at the door
home.feature.door.body: Members show the code in their app. Expired memberships are turned away, politely.

twoStep.loginIntro: Type the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
